name: AGM Fault Probe (Test Only)
author: Hakimi Tech Lab
description: Test-only fault isolation probe for sync throw, async rejection, and infinite loop timeout termination.

actions.label: 同步抛错 (throwSync)
actions.description: 在 Worker 内同步抛出异常验证错误隔离

actions.label: 异步拒绝 (rejectAsync)
actions.description: 返回 Rejected Promise 验证异步异常捕获

actions.label: 死循环熔断 (infiniteLoop)
actions.description: 执行 while(true){} 验证超时后 worker.terminate() 强杀
